sv.title: AQ Groups vd tankar aktier
sv.summary: Verkstadsbolaget AQ Groups vd James Ahrgren har på fredagen köpt 3.200 AQ Group-aktier för 217,45 kronor styck, eller totalt 0,7 miljoner kronor. Det framgår av inrapportering till Finansinspektionens insynsregister.

en.title: AQ Group CEO buys shares
en.summary: AQ Group CEO James Ahrgren, of the engineering company, bought 3,200 AQ Group shares at SEK 217.45 each, or SEK 0.7 million in total on Friday. This is according to a report to the Financial Supervisory Authority's insider register.
